Candidate: You are a Community Event Organizer negotiating with a Venue Manager to book a community hall. You are planning a relaxed Make & Meet where neighbors can try creative activities, share food, and meet local makers. Every offer must include a venue fee, an event date, and a closing time. The event can take place on any date in August or September next year. You prefer a lower fee, a later date, and a later closing time. The Venue Manager prefers a higher fee, an earlier date, and an earlier closing time because this makes the booking easier to staff and run. You may also negotiate practical details: ask to use the venue's projector or offer to bring your own; decide whether your volunteers or the venue staff will clean up; ask to cancel without a charge if you give notice; request early access to set up tables; and decide who provides door staff and refreshments.
